ruleDefinitions.name: ServiceDll Hijack
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects changes to the "ServiceDLL" value related to a service in the registry.
This is often used as a method of persistence.
 Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*ControlSet.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Services\\\\.*")) AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\Parameters\\\\ServiceDll$")) AND  NOT (Details = "C\:\\Windows\\system32\\spool\\drivers\\x64\\3\\PrintConfig\.dll" OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\system32\\lsass\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\Services\\\\NTDS\\\\Parameters\\\\ServiceDll$") AND Details = "\%\%systemroot\%\%\\system32\\ntdsa\.dll") OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\poqexec\.exe") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") AND Details = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\STAgent\.dll"))
